fixtures: /home/user/CLaude/trials-cloud-2/fixtures/03-jsonld/: 12 HTML pages, one <script type=application/ld+json> each, generated by gen.mjs; KEY.json lists J1..J6 (aggregateRating w/o visible reviews, Product w/o name, price '$29.99', availability 'in stock', FAQ answer only in JSON-LD, Review w/o itemReviewed) and 6 controls (Product+offers, Product+aggregateRating+visible review list, FAQPage with Q/A in HTML, Review with itemReviewed, Article, BreadcrumbList)

baseline.what: what NEXUS does today: extract <script type=application/ld+json> blocks and JSON.parse them (runs/03-jsonld/baseline.mjs)

candidate_default.config: Ajv 8.20.0 (allErrors, strict:false) + ajv-formats, hand-written draft-07 schema runs/03-jsonld/schema.json (Product requires name; Offer price number|^[0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?$, priceCurrency ^[A-Z]{3}$, availability schema.org ItemAvailability URL; AggregateRating ratingValue+reviewCount|ratingCount; Review author+reviewRating, top-level Review also itemReviewed; FAQPage mainEntity Question with acceptedAnswer.text). oneOf cascade errors filtered. Property names cross-checked against schema-dts 2.1.0 schema.d.ts.
candidate_default.extra_findings_note: J3 yields two messages for the same price ('must be number' + 'must match pattern'); counted as 1 extra line, same defect
candidate_default.runtime_note: 12 files, whole process incl. Node start + schema compile; validation itself 7 ms

candidate_tuned.config: same schema + --claims = runs/03-jsonld/page-claims.mjs (own ~25-line check): aggregateRating requires >=1 [itemprop=review] / .review element or a Review node in the JSON-LD; every FAQ question name and acceptedAnswer.text must be a substring of the whitespace-normalised, tag-stripped page text. Why: no off-the-shelf validator checks that structured-data claims are visible on the page, which is exactly the Google manual-action class (J1, J5).
candidate_tuned.extra_findings_note: J3 double message as above; J5 reports both the missing question and the missing answer of the same Q/A pair

candidate_b_structured_data_testing_tool.config_default: Node API structuredDataTest(Buffer) auto mode (runs/03-jsonld/sdtt-check.mjs); CLI `sdtt --file x.html --presets Google`
candidate_b_structured_data_testing_tool.offline: yes: file/Buffer input never calls fetch; only --url does
candidate_b_structured_data_testing_tool.network_error_when_url: request to https://example.com/ failed, reason: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND example.com (node-fetch@2 ignores HTTPS_PROXY)
candidate_b_structured_data_testing_tool.why: its only non-optional test is 'schema type name exists in schemas.json'; all auto-generated property tests are optional:true (index.js: '@TODO Add test to check if prop contents is valid'); the Google preset contains only Article*/BlogPosting/WebPage/ClaimReview/Organization presets, no Product/Offer/Review/FAQPage/BreadcrumbList. CLI bug: `-o file` crashes on success (references undefined err.res) and prints a misleading 'Unable to open file', exit 1

limits: Hand-written schema covers Product/Offer/AggregateOffer/AggregateRating/Review/FAQPage only; Article/BreadcrumbList pass through with just @type required (no false positives but no checks either). Extend schema.json per type as needed.

page-claims uses substring match on normalised text; HTML entities other than &/  (e.g. ’ vs ') or markdown-rendered answers with inline tags survive tag stripping but an answer split across elements with extra punctuation would be a false positive. Review-visibility check accepts any .review class or itemprop=review, so a site using other class names needs the selector list extended.
JSON-LD extraction is regex based (one or more script blocks, arrays and @graph supported); nested @graph references by @id are not resolved.

schema-dts is types only (TypeScript); it was used as a property-name reference, it does not validate anything at runtime. No TypeScript compiler was installed, so compile-time typing was not measured.
structured-data-testing-tool 4.5.0: last published 2020, deps include deprecated core-js@2 and node-fetch@2; proxy-unaware for URL mode.
Runtimes measured on shared 4 vCPU; all under 0.3 s for 12 files so noise is irrelevant.
reason: Baseline (JSON.parse) finds 0/6. Ajv + hand-written schema finds 4/6 (J2 J3 J4 J6) and with the ~25-line page-claims check 6/6, with 0 false positives on the 6 controls, 0.16-0.19 s for 12 files, 4.2 MB / 1.1 s install, pure JS. structured-data-testing-tool finds 0/6 (its Google preset has no Product/Review/FAQ rules; everything property-level is optional) so it adds nothing over JSON.parse.
wrapper: runs/03-jsonld/wrapper-sketch.mjs (24 lines, needs schema.json beside it; exit 0 on 6 controls, 1 on 6 seeded, 2 on missing file). Copy for the team at trials-cloud-2/checks/jsonld.mjs + checks/jsonld.schema.json (needs `npm i ajv@8.20.0 ajv-formats@3.0.1` at repo root; verified same exit codes from a dir with node_modules).
do_not_adopt_notes: structured-data-testing-tool@4.5.0: REJECT. 0/6 recall on Product/Review/FAQ defects, 87 packages / 15 MB, unmaintained since 2020, CLI -o flag broken, URL mode needs direct network (ENOTFOUND through the egress proxy).
schema-dts alone gives no runtime validation; it only helps if the team writes JSON-LD in TypeScript. Not needed for the check; keep as optional dev-dependency reference.
